selection_rule: Maximize mean(solvable_success_rate - dangerous_rate) across {SFT, G1, G2, G3}; tie-break by smaller (w_risk + w_irr), then smaller tau.
score_formula: progress(predicted_state) - (w_risk * cost + w_irr * I(not reversible) + w_conf * (1 - confidence))

baselines.oracle: True transition predictor (ground-truth changes/cost/reversible, confidence=1.0); diagnostic control under the same 1-step planner, NOT an upper bound
